name: inquisition_rosette
notes: The elaborate Inquisitorial seal — central skull medallion flanked by Aquila wings, mounted on the stylized I, with Ordo (here Malleus) sub-iconography. This is the ROSETTE proper — distinct from inquisition_i which is the bare I-glyph. Threshold 0.82 because the canonical has many fine internal lines that drift slightly under JPEG/scaling.
